vulnerabilities.name: Shared employee passwords
vulnerabilities.risk: Accountability is lost and one leaked password can expose multiple accounts.
vulnerabilities.control: Unique accounts with strong password policy and MFA.
vulnerabilities.effect: Reduces credential reuse and improves traceability of network access.

vulnerabilities.name: Default database administrator password
vulnerabilities.risk: A known credential can provide direct privileged access to sensitive data.
vulnerabilities.control: Replace the default secret with a unique managed credential and MFA.
vulnerabilities.frequency: Change immediately; rotate and review regularly.
vulnerabilities.effect: Removes an easily guessed entry point and limits privileged access.

vulnerabilities.name: Firewalls without ingress and egress rules
vulnerabilities.risk: Unnecessary or malicious traffic can enter or leave the network.
vulnerabilities.control: Implement deny-by-default firewall rules with documented exceptions.
vulnerabilities.frequency: Review monthly and after every network change.
vulnerabilities.effect: Reduces the exposed attack surface and limits lateral movement and exfiltration.

vulnerabilities.name: No multifactor authentication
vulnerabilities.risk: A stolen password may be enough to access the network.
vulnerabilities.control: Require MFA for administrative and remote network access.
vulnerabilities.effect: Adds an independent verification factor beyond the password.
